title: 第3章 三年之约被退婚的武者第4章 大胆一点直接编造修仙之法
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 楚风扫视了一眼少年手上端著的物品。
一株七寸长，通体泛红的人参。
一颗看不出什么品阶，但是丹气浓郁，令人心旷神怡的丹药。
百年血参，加上一枚丹药……
这小伙子家底还蛮厚的嘛，楚风通过茅屋中的书籍，对这个世界百姓的生活状况，还是有些许了解。
一般家庭，可拿不出来这些东西。
须是得王公贵族，亦或者是各大豪强势力，才有可能让族中的年轻子弟带上这些物件。
楚风眼珠子咕嚕的一转，嘴角微微一扬，却也不答，只是暗自思索：
“要不，装一波收下拜师礼？”
他倒也不是馋这一株血参和丹药。
他视线落在少年身上，见著少年的衣著打扮，以及其拿出来的物件来看。
对方肯定是出自大富大贵的家庭。
这个萧火火家里有厉害的武师，也说不定。
或许可以將这小子收下，然后想办法让这小子家里的武师，將他们一起带出这片林子？
不行，不行！
这个念头刚刚落下，便是被楚风不断的摇头否决了。
他望向少年，不禁皱起了眉头。
这小子家里底子丰厚是不错，可这也意味著他家里人应当都有些见识。
万一轻易的，就看出他楚风就是个什么都不懂的骗子。
这些人不得將他活活打死？
摇摇头，楚风长嘆一声。
这个想法，立即便是被他否决了。
还是得坚守住底线，不能被诱惑啊。
在这个弱肉强食的世界，可不讲什么道德法治。
行事可得处处小心，万一出了些什么差错，他这条小命可能都得交代出去。
而楚风不知道的是，他这副模样却是落到了萧火火的眼中。
依旧僵硬的跪拜著的少年，眼中闪过一抹慌乱绝望。
嘴角在不知觉间，压沉了下去。
他那颤抖著的眼眸看向眼前的世外高人，內心却只有一个念头：
“完了，全完了！”
“高人摇头了，他不愿意收我为徒。”
“果然，世外高人都如话本讲那般，没那么容易收徒。”
似乎想到了什么，萧火火的眼神坚毅，视死如归的闭上眼睛，內心一紧却是大胆的道：
“前辈，我知道您看不上我。”
“但，我有不得不变强的理由！”
“还请您，收我为徒。”
“求您了！”
说著，他便朝著楚风狠狠的磕了几个头。
砰砰砰。
脑袋重重的砸在地面上，传来一阵闷响。
当少年再度抬起头时，其额头上已经多处了一处血痕，正隱隱的朝外渗著鲜红的血渍。
楚风看著一愣，脑海中所想之事，此时也被拋之脑后。
这小子，看这副模样，是有故事？
content_en:
Chu Feng glanced at the items held by the young man.
A seven-inch long ginseng with a red body.
It's an elixir that doesn't have any discernible grade, but is rich in elixir energy and makes people feel relaxed and happy.
Hundred-year-old blood ginseng, plus a pill...
This young man's family is quite rich. Through the books in the hut, Chu Feng still has some understanding of the living conditions of the people in this world.
Ordinary families cannot afford these things.
Only the princes, nobles, or major powerful forces can allow the young members of the clan to bring these objects.
Chu Feng rolled his eyes and raised the corners of his mouth slightly, but he didn't answer, he just thought to himself:
"How about pretending to accept the apprenticeship ceremony?"
He was not greedy for this blood ginseng and elixir.
His eyes fell on the young man, looking at his clothes and the items he took out.
The other party must come from a wealthy family.
There might be a powerful martial artist in Xiao Huohuo's family.
Maybe you can take this kid in, and then find a way to get the kid's family's martial artist to take them out of the forest together?
No, no!
As soon as this thought came to mind, Chu Feng shook his head and rejected it.
He looked at the young man and frowned.
It's good that this kid's family has a rich background, but this also means that his family members should have some knowledge.
If it were easy, it would be obvious that he, Chu Feng, is a liar who doesn't understand anything.
These people weren't allowed to beat him to death?
Shaking his head, Chu Feng sighed.
This idea was immediately rejected by him.
You still have to stick to the bottom line and not be tempted.
In this world where the jungle prevails, there is no such thing as morality and the rule of law.
He had to be careful in everything he did. If something went wrong, his life might be at stake.
But what Chu Feng didn't know was that his appearance fell into Xiao Huohuo's eyes.
The boy who was still kneeling stiffly had a flash of panic and despair in his eyes.
The corners of his mouth sank unconsciously.
His trembling eyes looked at the worldly expert in front of him, but there was only one thought in his heart:
"It's over, it's all over!"
"The master shook his head. He is not willing to accept me as his disciple."
"Sure enough, the worldly masters are as true to their word as they say, and it is not easy to accept disciples."
As if he had thought of something, Xiao Huohuo's eyes were firm, and he closed his eyes as if he were about to die. His heart tightened, but he said boldly:
"Senior, I know you look down on me."
"But, I have a reason to become stronger!"
"Please also accept me as your disciple."
"Please!"
As he said that, he kowtowed fiercely to Chu Feng several times.
Bang bang bang.
His head hit the ground hard, and there was a muffled sound.
When the young man raised his head again, there were already multiple blood stains on his forehead, and bright red blood stains were faintly oozing out.
Chu Feng looked at it for a moment, and what he was thinking was now forgotten.
This kid, looks like this, does he have a story?
